4_decisions.bf16_sum_atol_rationale: probabilities stored bf16; measured max |sum-1| 1.953e-3; bf16 eps at 1.0 = 7.8125e-3 -> atol 4e-3 = 2x measured

6a_cache.finding: Qwen3_5Model.forward declares use_cache only via **kwargs (TransformersKwargs), which the original explicit-parameter gate missed: the config default (use_cache=true) built a DynamicCache per extraction (bug found by this battery, fixed in jevx/adapters/base.py). Raw default-mode wrapper calls still build a DynamicCache (model default) and are drift-free: identical sequential forwards are bitwise equal and cache/no-cache sequences agree exactly (0.0).

6bc_padding.interpretation: GDN path zeroes padded tokens pre-recurrence (conv bias=False, so pad steps inject exact zeros); full-attention layers use RoPE whose attention scores depend only on RELATIVE positions, and a uniform padding shift preserves all intra-row offsets — measured left/right and batch/alone differences therefore sit at bf16 kernel-rounding scale. JevX bar: not worse than backbone-alone.

ValueError: JevX could not call the backbone Qwen3_5Model with the prepared inputs (keys: ['attention_mask', 'input_ids', 'pixel_values', 'use_cache']). Upstream AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'device'
This is an INPUT/MODALITY mismatch, not a model bug: text inputs (input_ids/attention_mask) combined with vision pixel_values, or pixel_values / input_features passed without the companion metadata their processor emits (e.g. image_grid_thw for a vision-language backbone), or a modality routed under the wrong key. Pass the FULL processor output for this modality — processor(text=..., images=..., return_tensors='pt') — or a text-only state; JevX forwards declared backbone kwargs unchanged and never invents vision/audio metadata.
